name: smwblocks-reset-yoshi-coin-count
title: Reset Yoshi Coin Count
description:
This block resets the Yoshi Coin counter.
Also clears the flag if all have been collected but only if the level hasn't been exited in the meantime.
- get 5 coins - touch block - flag cleared.
- get 5 coins - win/die - reenter level - touch block - flag remains.
(see ASM on to make it always delete the flag)
